objective: Make the M4 exact-projection assertion deterministic, so a red result means a regression and a green result means its absence.
falsifiable_claim: The claim fails if the exact-projection assertion in verify-m4-outcome-room-system-spine.mjs can return a different verdict across runs at one commit with no source difference.
in_scope: Root-cause the nondeterminism in the exact-projection comparison: ordering, timing against admission durability, or a shared-resource dependency in the isolated plane.
Make the assertion deterministic, or make its precondition explicit so an unmet precondition refuses as environmental rather than reporting a substantive failure.
out_of_scope: Retrying the assertion until it passes. A retry converts a flaky red into a slow green and destroys the signal this record exists to restore.
Loosening the assertion. It caught nothing false; it reported red at 1/98 under conditions nobody has isolated.

aggregate_disposition.why: Owner ruling 2026-08-03. M4 is certified and its 98/98 bar stands; binding this would reopen a certified stage for a verifier defect rather than a substrate one. It is filed because a proof that can flake RED can also mask a real regression in the noise -- the danger is not the false alarm, it is the true alarm nobody believes.

implementation_actions: Instrument the exact-projection comparison to capture both sides when it disagrees.
Reproduce under the recorded conditions of the red run: root filesystem at 82%, shared 591G target directory, CARGO_INCREMENTAL unset.
Add a deterministic precondition or an explicit environmental refusal.
positive_proof: The exact-projection assertion returns the identical verdict across repeated runs at one commit, under both constrained and unconstrained disk and load.
An unmet precondition surfaces as a named environmental refusal, distinguishable from a substantive assertion failure.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: Reject a retry loop that masks nondeterminism by re-running until green; the verdict must be stable, not eventually favourable.
Reject an environmental refusal that is reported as a passing assertion, which would convert an unmeasured condition into a claim of correctness.
remaining_nonclaims: This record does not claim the red run indicated any substrate defect; two subsequent runs at the same commit passed 98/98 and the commit range carried zero .rs changes.
This record does not claim the cause is known. The conditions of the red run are recorded, not explained.
rollback_or_stop_rule: Stop if determinism cannot be achieved without weakening what the assertion proves; a weaker assertion that never flakes is worse than a strong one that sometimes does.
current_implementation_evidence: FILED 2026-08-03 from the M5 review-fix pass. The M4 aggregate returned 97/98 at c76c33450 with a single failure -- RUNTIME RESULT REFUSAL: exact goal bytes are sealed and post-receipt substitution is detected, where every component held (closed=true, receipt_root=true, facts_root=true, 409, work_result_output_truth_diverged, whole_tree_unchanged=true) EXCEPT exact=false. The commit range eb1e1f265..c76c33450 contains ZERO .rs files, so the daemon binary was identical to the one that passed 98/98. Two subsequent runs at c76c33450 passed 98/98 each, reclassifying the failure as verifier or environment nondeterminism. Conditions differed: the red run had the root filesystem at 82% with a shared 591G target directory and CARGO_INCREMENTAL unset; both green runs had root at 48-49%, a per-run target directory, and CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0. That correlation is recorded, NOT claimed as cause. Failing bytes retained at docs/evidence/m5-event-substrate/flake-evidence/.
